# PR #3424: Patch: a signature animation for every Classic+ Legendary and Mythic, one concept per card

Closes #3399

## Not green yet: one check needs a person to decide

CI's `web` job will fail on one test: `apps/web/src/fx/cards/tiers.test.ts`, `R3332000 every signature ends within its rarity's and type's ceiling…`. Its first failure is `classicplus-012-1 burst at 400: expected 1388 to be less than or equal to 1200`. This is the plan's Open question 1, and I left the test unchanged.

That test times every cue of a card's whole gallery play from the play's start, including the event rows every card shares and the shared takeover. Under that measure:
- **Legendary Spells:** every one fails. Its text's events come in entries that start after its 400 ms cast, and a burst there ends at 400 + 900 = 1,300 ms or later, past its 1,200 ms ceiling.
- **Mythic Spells:** the shared takeover alone runs 1,400 + 700 = 2,100 ms, past their 1,950 ms ceiling.
- **Overall:** I measured 25 of the 35 over that ceiling.

What I built instead is the plan's per-beat check, in `classicplus/signatures.test.ts`. Each card's own cues (entrance, recipe, takeover) must end within its ceiling, counted from the start of the entry they play in. All 35 pass it. A person should choose one of two fixes:
- **Recommended:** change R3332000 so the budget counts only a signature's own cues, each from the start of its own entry. That is what the per-beat check already does.
- **Or:** set new ceilings for the whole-play measure.

Changing that check myself would be weakening a check to get to green, so I didn't.

## What changed

- **35 signatures.** Every Classic+ Legendary and Mythic, tokens counted by printed rarity, now has `signature: true` in `classicplus.json5`, its own recipe in `fx/cards/classicplus/`, and is off `SIGNATURE_PENDING`.
  - **Units and Field Spells** land with an entrance of their own, play their text's beat in a recipe, and wear an aura of their own on their tile.
  - **Spells** have a cast of their own: the recipe claims the card's own `cardPlayed`, then the events its text emits.
  - **Rollback** gains a clock-face cast before its rewind.
- **Auras (R3399001).**
  - A `{ bespoke }` entry can now carry an `aura`; `auraOfEntry` reads either kind.
  - A face-up Unit wears a `zone` aura on its own unit zone. This applies only to cards whose type is Unit, so a Field Spell animated onto the unit row keeps its aura in the backrow.
  - There are 18 new looks, each used by one card.
  - Such an aura replaces the default tile aura from #3342 (`tile.ts`). #3342 merged after the plan, and without this change those tiles would have drawn both auras.
- **Mythic takeovers (R3399002).** The four Mythics have their own looks: `zealot`, `portal`, `stair`, `vineyard`. Each is a full-screen SVG picture (`fx/takeoverArt.ts`) drawn over the darkened board, and the Reduce Motion still shows the same picture without motion.
- **Hidden cards (R3399003).** A beat only the owner may see (Portal's Discover, KY's Test's problems) plays on the owner's seat only. Every card flying to a hand or deck is drawn as a card back.
- **Sounds (R3399004).** Each of the 35 has its own procedural effect in `card-audio.json5`, on `play` for Units and `cast` for the rest. `iceCrack` left the effects list because nothing uses it any more, and a test fails on unused effects.
- **Gallery.** `/dev/fx` and the component spec now start a play with the card in the viewer's hand (`galleryHandOf`). Without that, a Spell's cast and a Mythic Spell's takeover had nothing to anchor to and were not drawn in the browser.
- **Paperwork.** Rulings R3399000–R3399004, their §11 paragraphs in `spec/pending/3399.md`, "amended by" notes on R2722001, R2787000, R2795000, R3332000 and R3342000, plus updates to `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md` and `apps/web/README.md`.

Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

Part of #3330. Blocked by #3332, whose signature tier, takeovers for any card, budgets and ratchet these entries use.

The owner asked (2026-11-06) for every Legendary and Mythic to have an animation of its own, as in Hearthstone, instead of one shared animation.

### Today

- Classic+ has 16 Legendaries and Mythics: 15 play a shared motif (`send` alone for 9 of them) and 1 has a recipe of its own (Rollback's `rollbackSweep`), which grows into a full signature.
- 19 of its tokens are printed Legendary or Mythic (18 Legendary and 1 Mythic, Mythic Grape): 10 play a shared motif, 1 a set piece (Frozen Wastes' `vortex`) and 8 nothing of their own (`none: token`).

### What it should be

- **Every card gets a signature.** Every card in the table gets a `signature` entry in its set's `apps/web/src/fx/cards/classicplus.json5` table, with its recipe in `apps/web/src/fx/cards/classicplus/`, built from its concept, and leaves `SIGNATURE_PENDING`.
- **The beats by type:**
  - a Unit plays an entrance of its own, then its text's beat;
  - a Spell plays a cast of its own;
  - a permanent plays its arrival, its text's beat, and a standing aura of its own on its tile.
- **A Mythic's takeover is its own,** with its own art filling the screen.
- **A concept is the target, not a script.** The builder keeps each card's idea, and may move a beat to fit the budgets or the events the view carries.
- **The rules every signature keeps:**
  - the signature budgets (#3332), R200, and one set piece per action;
